niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers interfaces that feel spacious, clearly structured, and visually focused. They favor low-clutter layouts with strong hierarchy, grouped content, and obvious primary actions. They often like rounded cards, modal-style containment, and softer visual treatment. They also repeatedly respond well to warm, welcoming, human-centered imagery and friendlier copy. Their color preference is mixed by context, but they more often favor cohesive, intentional palettes over generic or harsh ones, with a slight tilt toward lighter/softer themes except when a saturated dark treatment is used to create strong hierarchy and emphasis.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers generous whitespace, fewer visible items at once, less clutter, and layouts that feel breathable rather than crowded or tightly stacked.
Prefers strong hierarchy with clearly grouped sections, chunked information, distinct headings, and one obvious focal path instead of competing elements.
Prefers rounded cards, pill-like controls, softer containers, and gentler overall visual treatment rather than sharp, rigid, or square-edged UI.
Prefers centered modal/card overlays, dimmed or blurred backdrops, and contained panels that isolate content and improve focus over full-page or visually exposed layouts.
Prefers warm lifestyle imagery, welcoming presentation, softer brand mood, and reassuring/supportive messaging over colder, abstract, or utilitarian treatments.
Prefers CTAs that are easy to find and visually emphasized, with clear primary-vs-secondary distinction and action placement that feels integrated and obvious.
Prefers shorter copy, bullet points, summarized details, and scan-friendly presentation over dense paragraphs, legal-style text, or overly explanatory content.
